situation.en: You're writing a market report for your team lead, James, in London. It's due on Thursday, but the sales figures from Dana's team are three days late, and the report can't be accurate without them. James has just emailed you to check on it. This scenario is written practice: every reply is an email.
situation.he: אתם כותבים דוח שוק עבור ראש הצוות שלכם, ג'יימס, שיושב בלונדון. מועד ההגשה הוא ביום חמישי, אבל נתוני המכירות מהצוות של דנה מתעכבים בשלושה ימים, ובלעדיהם הדוח לא יהיה מדויק. ג'יימס בדיוק שלח לכם מייל כדי לבדוק מה המצב. בתרחיש הזה מתרגלים כתיבה: כל תשובה היא מייל.

goal.en: Write polite, clear emails: explain the problem briefly, ask for a new deadline, offer what you can deliver in the meantime and confirm the next steps.
goal.he: לכתוב מיילים מנומסים וברורים: להסביר את הבעיה בקצרה, לבקש מועד חדש, להציע מה אפשר להגיש בינתיים ולאשר את הצעדים הבאים.

phrases.note: 'Hi' and a first name is normal in most work emails. 'Dear James,' is more formal.

phrases.en: Subject: New date for the market report?
phrases.note: Say what the email is about in a few words.

phrases.en: I wanted to give you a heads-up about the report.
phrases.he: רציתי לעדכן אותך מראש לגבי הדוח.
phrases.note: 'A heads-up' is advance notice. Normal in emails to colleagues.

phrases.en: Unfortunately, the sales figures haven't arrived yet.
phrases.he: לצערי, נתוני המכירות עוד לא הגיעו.

phrases.en: Would it be possible to move the deadline to Monday?
phrases.he: האם אפשר לדחות את מועד ההגשה ליום שני?
phrases.note: A polite, standard way to ask for a change.

phrases.en: In the meantime, I can send you the other sections.
phrases.he: בינתיים אוכל לשלוח לך את שאר הפרקים.

phrases.note: Say it once. Apologising again and again sounds weak in a work email.

phrases.en: Please let me know if that works for you.
phrases.he: אשמח לדעת אם זה מתאים לך.

phrases.en: I've copied Dana, who's handling the sales figures.
phrases.he: הוספתי לתכתובת את דנה, שאחראית על נתוני המכירות.
phrases.note: 'Copied' or 'cc'd' = you added someone to the email.
A safe sign-off for most work emails. 'Best,' and 'Thanks,' are more relaxed.

model_dialogue.speaker: partner
model_dialogue.text: Hi, just checking in on the market report. Are we still on track for Thursday? Thanks, James

model_dialogue.speaker: you
model_dialogue.text: Hi James, thanks for checking in. Unfortunately, the sales figures from Dana's team are three days late, and I need them for the main section. Would it be possible to move the deadline to Monday? Best, Noa

model_dialogue.speaker: partner
model_dialogue.text: Thanks for flagging this early. Monday is tight, because I'm presenting to the client on Tuesday morning. What can you send me by Thursday?

model_dialogue.speaker: you
model_dialogue.text: I can send you the other three sections on Thursday, and the full report by noon on Monday. That gives you Monday afternoon to review it. Would that work?

model_dialogue.speaker: partner
model_dialogue.text: That works. Can you loop Dana in, so she knows the figures are now urgent?

model_dialogue.speaker: you
model_dialogue.text: Will do. I've copied Dana. Dana, could you send the sales figures by Friday, please?

model_dialogue.speaker: partner
model_dialogue.text: Thanks. And if the figures are late again, what's the plan?

model_dialogue.speaker: you
model_dialogue.text: If they haven't arrived by Friday, I'll use last quarter's figures and mark them clearly as estimates. I'll keep you posted either way.

model_dialogue.speaker: partner
model_dialogue.text: Perfect. Thanks for keeping me in the loop.

model_dialogue.speaker: you
model_dialogue.text: Thanks for being flexible. I'll send the first sections on Thursday.

practice.partner: Hi, just checking in on the market report. Are we still on track for Thursday? Thanks, James

options.text: Hi James, thanks for checking in. Unfortunately, the sales figures from Dana's team are three days late, and I need them for the main section. Would it be possible to move the deadline to Monday?

feedback.en: Everything a good request email needs: the problem in one sentence, the reason, and a clear, polite request with a date.
feedback.he: כל מה שמייל בקשה טוב צריך: הבעיה במשפט אחד, הסיבה, ובקשה ברורה ומנומסת עם תאריך.

options.text: No. Dana's team didn't send me anything, so it's not my fault.

feedback.en: Defensive and blaming. Your team lead needs facts and a plan, not who's at fault.
feedback.he: מתגונן ומאשים. ראש הצוות צריך עובדות ותוכנית, לא לדעת מי אשם.

options.text: Hi James, I'm so sorry, I feel terrible, but I have a big problem with the report and I don't think I can finish it on time. I've been working on it every evening this week. I'm really, really sorry.

feedback.en: Polite, but it has too many apologies and no clear request, and it sounds more worrying than it is. James doesn't need to hear about your evenings. One 'sorry' is enough; then explain the reason and suggest a new date.
feedback.he: מנומס, אבל יש בו יותר מדי התנצלויות ואין בקשה ברורה, והוא נשמע מדאיג יותר ממה שהמצב באמת. ג'יימס לא צריך לשמוע על הערבים שלכם. 'סליחה' אחת מספיקה, ואחריה מסבירים את הסיבה ומציעים מועד חדש.

model_replies: Hi James, thanks for checking in. Unfortunately, the sales figures from Dana's team are three days late, and I need them for the main section. Would it be possible to move the deadline to Monday?
Hi James, I wanted to give you a heads-up: I'm still waiting for the sales figures, so the report may be late. Could we move the deadline to Monday?

points.en: Name the problem: the figures are late

practice.partner: Thanks for flagging this early. Monday is tight, because I'm presenting to the client on Tuesday morning. What can you send me by Thursday?

options.text: I can send some things on Thursday.

feedback.en: A start, but vague. Say exactly what and when, so James can plan: 'the other three sections on Thursday'.
feedback.he: התחלה, אבל כללי. כתבו בדיוק מה ומתי, כדי שג'יימס יוכל לתכנן: the other three sections on Thursday.

options.text: I can send you the other three sections on Thursday, and the full report by noon on Monday. That gives you Monday afternoon to review it. Would that work?

feedback.en: A concrete compromise: part of the work on time, the rest early enough for his meeting. The question at the end invites a quick yes.
feedback.he: פשרה קונקרטית: חלק מהעבודה בזמן, והשאר מוקדם מספיק לפני הפגישה שלו. השאלה בסוף מזמינה 'כן' מהיר.

options.text: Nothing, sorry. Without the figures I can't do anything.

feedback.en: Probably not true, and it sounds unhelpful. Offer what you can do now: the sections that don't need the figures.
feedback.he: כנראה לא נכון, וגם נשמע לא משתף פעולה. הציעו מה אפשר לעשות עכשיו: הפרקים שלא צריכים את הנתונים.

model_replies: I can send you the other three sections on Thursday, and the full report by noon on Monday. That gives you Monday afternoon to review it. Would that work?
By Thursday I can send everything except the sales section. Would it help if I sent the full report first thing on Monday?

points.en: Say what you can send by Thursday
points.he: אומרים מה אפשר לשלוח עד יום חמישי

points.en: Give a date for the rest
Check that it works for James

practice.partner: That works. Can you loop Dana in, so she knows the figures are now urgent?

options.text: What does 'loop' mean? Sorry, I don't understand your English.

feedback.en: It sounds as if James's English is the problem. If you don't know an expression, check neutrally: 'Do you mean I should add Dana to this email?'
feedback.he: נשמע כאילו האנגלית של ג'יימס היא הבעיה. אם ביטוי לא מוכר לכם, בודקים בטון ניטרלי: Do you mean I should add Dana to this email?

options.text: Will do. I've copied Dana. Dana, could you send the sales figures by Friday, please?

feedback.en: Done straight away: Dana is on the email, and she gets a clear, polite request with a date.
feedback.he: מבוצע מיד: דנה נוספה למייל, ומקבלת בקשה ברורה ומנומסת עם תאריך.

options.text: OK, I will call her later today and tell her that the figures are urgent now.

feedback.en: A call works, but in an email 'loop in' usually means adding the person to the thread, so James can see it's done: 'I've copied Dana.'
feedback.he: גם שיחה תעבוד, אבל במייל loop in פירושו בדרך כלל להוסיף את האדם לשרשור, כדי שג'יימס יראה שזה בוצע: I've copied Dana.

model_replies: Will do. I've copied Dana. Dana, could you send the sales figures by Friday, please?
Sure, I've added Dana to this email. Dana, would Friday be possible for the figures?

points.en: Ask Dana for the figures, with a date
points.he: מבקשים מדנה את הנתונים, עם מועד

practice.partner: Thanks. And if the figures are late again, what's the plan?

options.text: Then it's not my problem anymore.

feedback.en: It sounds as if you don't care about the result. Offer a backup plan instead.
feedback.he: נשמע כאילו התוצאה לא מעניינת אתכם. עדיף להציע תוכנית גיבוי.

options.text: If they will be late again, I will tell you.

feedback.en: Clear, but after 'if', use the present for the future: 'If they're late again, I'll let you know.' A backup plan would make it stronger.
feedback.he: ברור, אבל אחרי if משתמשים בהווה גם לעתיד: If they're late again, I'll let you know. תוכנית גיבוי תחזק את התשובה.

options.text: If they haven't arrived by Friday, I'll use last quarter's figures and mark them clearly as estimates. I'll keep you posted either way.

feedback.en: A realistic backup plan, honest about the estimates, plus a promise to update him.
feedback.he: תוכנית גיבוי מציאותית, שקופה לגבי ההערכות, ובנוסף הבטחה לעדכן אותו.

model_replies: If they haven't arrived by Friday, I'll use last quarter's figures and mark them clearly as estimates. I'll keep you posted either way.
If they're late again, I'll let you know on Friday and we can decide together.

points.en: Say what you will do if they are late again
points.he: אומרים מה תעשו אם יתעכבו שוב

practice.partner: Perfect. Thanks for keeping me in the loop.

options.text: Thank you so so much!!! You are the best boss ever!!! I promise it will never happen again!!!

feedback.en: Too much for a work email: rows of exclamation marks, big praise and a dramatic promise sound unprofessional. Keep it warm and simple.
feedback.he: מוגזם למייל עבודה: שורות של סימני קריאה, מחמאות גדולות והבטחה דרמטית נשמעים לא מקצועיים. עדיף חם ופשוט.

feedback.en: Polite, but short. Thanking him for being flexible and confirming the next step closes the thread well.
feedback.he: מנומס, אבל קצר. תודה על הגמישות ואישור הצעד הבא סוגרים את השרשור יפה.

options.text: Thanks for being flexible. I'll send the first sections on Thursday.

feedback.en: Warm and professional: a thank-you for his flexibility and a reminder of what happens next.
feedback.he: חם ומקצועי: תודה על הגמישות ותזכורת למה שיקרה בהמשך.

model_replies: Thanks for being flexible. I'll send the first sections on Thursday.
Thanks, James. The first sections will be with you on Thursday.

roleplay.persona: James, a team lead in London. Fair and calm, but under pressure from a client; he writes short, friendly emails and expects clear dates.
roleplay.complication: James can't simply move the deadline to Monday, because he presents to the client on Tuesday morning. The learner has to offer a compromise (part of the work earlier, the rest later) and confirm the new dates in writing. James also asks the learner to 'loop in' Dana, whose team owes the figures, and asks what happens if the figures are late again.
roleplay.opening_line: Hi, just checking in on the market report. Are we still on track for Thursday? Thanks, James

culture.en: Ask for more time as early as you can. In most workplaces an early heads-up is welcome, while a last-minute surprise damages trust.
culture.he: מבקשים עוד זמן מוקדם ככל האפשר. ברוב מקומות העבודה עדכון מוקדם מתקבל בברכה, והפתעה של הרגע האחרון פוגעת באמון.

culture.en: A good request email is short: the problem in one sentence, a new date, and what you can deliver in the meantime.
culture.he: מייל בקשה טוב הוא קצר: הבעיה במשפט אחד, מועד חדש, ומה אפשר להגיש בינתיים.

culture.en: 'Thanks for flagging this' means 'thanks for telling me about the problem'. It's a positive reply, not a complaint.
culture.he: Thanks for flagging this פירושו 'תודה שסיפרת לי על הבעיה'. זו תגובה חיובית, לא תלונה.

variants.note: Both are safe in either country. 'Cheers,' is friendly and mostly British or Australian.
In the US, 5/12 is May 12; in the UK it's 5 December. Write the month as a word.
